description: Describe Stockfilm's AI-training dataset product: eligible catalog counts, the three fixed-price tiers (free evaluation sample; $25,000 research for academic institutions; commercial at $3.00/clip proxies or $10.00/clip 4K masters, $10,000 minimum), payment rails (card for small proxy orders, bank wire for 4K and larger orders), available filters, the agreement version and sha256, and the purchase workflow. AI-training rights are sold only this way, never per clip and never exclusively.
name: describe_training_dataset
